fixture_setup: Final fixtures are byte-for-byte copies in fixtures/final/ (SHA256SUMS) and are served from GitHub Pages. On the deployed site staff applied legacy_export.json and scale_fixture.json once through Operations -> Legacy migration (the run reports are under Previous runs); reviewers may re-run either file (it is idempotent) or use Preview only. R1 seed data and R4 partner/collaboration fixtures remain. Company-site fixtures are published unchanged at fixtures/r4/ on GitHub Pages (URLs above, SHA-256 in fixtures/r4/SHA256SUMS). Import them through the staff UI; nothing is pre-loaded. collaboration_seed.json is reproduced by staff through the Collaborations form (North Shore Simulations: 2025 past public, 2026 current public; Superior Immersive Labs: 2026 current private). R1-R3 fixture students/projects remain loaded by seed_db.py.
test_access: Staff: one shared staff test account, given only in the Moodle Final Product Result Online text under Reviewer test access (sign in at admin.html, then Operations). Students/contributors: reviewers sign in with their own GitHub account at login.html and verify their own @algomau.ca email, then claim or create profiles/projects with synthetic data. Public visitor: no account. No passwords or tokens are in this repository.
